items.text: Asks how the application handles partial regional failures where some services are available but others are not, creating split-brain scenarios.
Questions how the design ensures idempotency of operations during retries after partial failures or network timeouts.
Identifies the need for circuit breakers to prevent cascading failures when cross-region calls experience latency spikes.
Asks about the strategy for schema migrations and backward compatibility during rolling deployments across regions.
Questions how the design handles clock skew between regions for timestamp-based conflict resolution.
Identifies the need for canary deployments and feature flags to control rollouts and mitigate risk.
Asks about monitoring and alerting for data drift between regions before it causes business impact.
Questions how the design handles regulatory requirements for data residency when users travel between regions.

weakAnswers: The design looks good overall, just need to consider scalability.
Make sure to add proper error handling and logging.
Consider security implications of cross-region data transfer.
The team should think about future expansion to more regions.
Add more details to the testing plan for better coverage.
